RUNNER.name: DRAGON RUNNER — hole break-up, hold to break-down

universe.note: the edge lives on volatile $500M–5B names; the $100M–500M band showed no runner edge on the full universe; calm large caps have none

RUNNER.exit: hole breaks down (two closes below the lower level). Flatten exits rejected on the full universe: slope-to-zero and 30 %-of-peak both captured less than holding to the break-down in every cap band.

meaning.hole_up: Dragon volatility hole broke up: two closes above MA10 + 1.4·ATR set at the last confirmed pivot
meaning.fresh: the break happened within the last 3 bars

evidence.matrix, $300M–5B & ATR≥5%, holdout 2024+: +0.7 % per trade; with volume ≥ 1.5× on the break +3.9 % (n 421); volume×range top decile +5.4 % (n 366)
evidence.live TradingView, ten $300M–5B names 201: plain hole entry: 9/10 profitable, median +199 %, PF 1.95, ~28 trades, 42 % winners, median DD 44 % (buy-and-hold median +22 %); volume ≥1.5× filter: 8/10, median +137 %, fewer trades
evidence.shape: 42–46 % winners, big average, single-name drawdown ~40 %: a many-name portfolio, never one chart
evidence.does not work: calm large caps (ATR < 3 %), bracket exits, liquid names ≥ $10M/day (−3.4 %)

RUNNER.regime: no runner entries while the name is in a long downtrend (21-day SMA more than 5 % below the 200-day): the runner's gain over an in-force entry is +1.8 % outside that state and ≈ 0 inside it (holdout); DRAGON TREE hands the downtrend state to the washout lane

STRUCTURE.name: SUPER STRUCTURE — washout at the low
STRUCTURE.exit: bracket +2 / −4 ATR, 20 bars (the 10-bar close is competitive)

meaning.asym20: 20-bar path dominated by drawdown (max drawup ÷ max drawdown in the bottom decile)
meaning.clv: close in the bottom 8 % of the day's range
meaning.d_pl: close within 0.76 ATR of the last swing low or below it

evidence.holdout 2024+ (2,174 names): +0.20 ATR over random, z 3.6, 64 % winners, n 1,433; +1.49 % per trade vs +0.89 % random
evidence.training eras: positive in all four, bear +0.46, bull +0.36
evidence.by regime (holdout): +0.35 ATR outside a long downtrend (n 742), ≈ +0.03 inside (n 688); in-sample +0.46 inside, +0.35 outside

FORCE.name: SUPER FORCE — inefficient decline below the gold band

meaning.eff10: 10-bar path efficiency in the bottom quartile (choppy)
meaning.gold: close below the Diamond gold band (EMA 21/34/55)
meaning.lr20: 20-bar regression slope in the bottom quartile (falling)
meaning.macd_hist: MACD histogram in the bottom quartile

evidence.holdout 2024+: +0.28 ATR over random, z 4.8, 66 % winners, n 1,249; +1.38 % per trade vs +0.71 % random
evidence.caution: other FORCE lineages with roc120 instead of gold failed the holdout (−0.2 ATR)

ENERGY.name: SUPER ENERGY — capitulation gap on huge volume

meaning.gap: opened at least 0.19 ATR above the prior close
meaning.metabolic: volume ratio × range in the top decile
meaning.st_dist: close more than 2.2 ATR below the SuperTrend(10,3) line

evidence.holdout 2024+: +0.18 ATR over random, z 2.0, 65 % winners, n 552; +1.86 % per trade vs +0.95 % random
evidence.alternative cell (round 4): volatility expanding from quiet volume outside a squeeze: +0.14 ATR, z 2.3, +0.40 on bear bars

TREE.name: DRAGON TREE — runner in trends, washout in downtrends
TREE.rule: regime hand-over: RUNNER when 21-SMA ≥ 200-SMA × 0.95, else SUPER STRUCTURE with the +2/−4 bracket

evidence.why: runner Δ collapses in long downtrends; washout stays ≥ 0 there
evidence.live TradingView, same ten $300M–5B name: CAUTION on bases: the plain-runner numbers (median +199 %, DD 44 %) come from the Homily twin with a $10k starting capital; TREE and its variants start with $100k, so their % are 10× smaller by construction. In dollars per $10k trade unit over the ten names: TREE ≈ $366k (10/10 profitable, ~58 trades/name, 44 % winners), regime-gated runner alone ≈ $328k (9/10, ~41 trades), plain runner ≈ $229k (9/10, ~28 trades, 2018+ window). Same-script three-way comparison in bend/data/live_tree_*.csv
evidence.same script, same base, ten names 2016-2: runner ungated: $366k total, 10/10 profitable, ~64 trades/name, median DD 10.5 %, PF 1.68 · runner regime-gated: $328k, 9/10, ~41 trades, DD 6.1 %, PF 1.54 · TREE (gated runner + washout): $366k, 10/10, ~58 trades, DD 7.3 %, PF 1.48 → TREE keeps the ungated total with the drawdown cut by a third; the gate alone cuts drawdown but loses ~10 % of the total
